newsitem.title: JAPAN: Denso to supply auto parts to Aisin's customers.
newsitem.headline: Denso to supply auto parts to Aisin's customers.

text.p: Denso Corp said on Monday that it was preparing to supply auto parts to customers of Aisin Seiki Co Ltd on its behalf following a fire at the weekend which destroyed one of Aisin's auto parts plants.
A Denso spokesman told Reuters that the company had received a request from Aisin to help supply brake-related products to Aisin's clients, which include Toyota Motor Corp.
"We're preparing to deal with the situation," the spokesman said. But he declined to comment on the likely volume or timeframe, saying the situation was still in a state of flux.
A fire at an Aisin plant on Saturday halted output of some brake parts supplied to Toyota Motor, which holds a 23.2 percent stake in Denso and 22.6 percent in Aisin.

Earlier on Monday, a Toyota spokesman told Reuters that the company may be forced to suspend its domestic production for a full day on Tuesday because of the fire. Toyota produces about 14,000 cars per day at its 12 plants in Japan.
The Toyota spokesman said Toyota would restart some of its production lines from Wednesday and that the company had decided to drop plans to operate its factories for an extra day next Saturday.
